Column requirements of the tales consumers

Source: R/requirements.R
tales_requirements.Rd

What each function needs of a tales object. This is distinct from the class's own column contract, which says what makes an object valid: a valid tales may still lack what a given operation needs.

Usage

tales_requirements()

Value

A tibble of function, requirement kind, and columns.

Details

tales_compare()

aa_seq or dna_seq (translated)

tales_align()

whichever of rvd / dom_code residue_col names

tales_rvd_strings()

rvd

tales_coded_strings()

dom_code

tales_domain_codes()

dom_code and aa_seq; rvd included when present

plot() on a tales

rvd, aa_seq, domain_type; seqnames adds a facet, alignment_position enables the aligned layout

tale_parts_to_rvd()

rvd

repeat_to_rvd_map_distalr()

dom_code, rvd
